name: Planar Dwarf
body:
Note Generally more powerful than their Material Plane counterparts, this humanoid variant are more likely be encountered as NPCs but may occasionally be allowed as player characters for high-powered campaigns.

While mundane dwarves lean toward Lawful Good, planar dwarves are more varied in their alignment, and can be found on all of the Upper Planes, as well as the Plane of Neutrality, the Plane of Law, and occasionally the Lower Planes. If anything, they are even more obsessed with mining and crafting than their kinfolk from the Material Plane. They come across as extremely surly and short-tempered, albeit also very brave and dedicated.

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Str, +2 Con, +2 Int, +2 Wis, –2 Dex, –4 Cha. This trait alters ability scores.
Languages You begin play speaking Celestial and Dwarven. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Abyssal, Common, Elven, Giant, Gnome, Goblin, Infernal, and Terran. This trait alters languages.
Master Craftsman You gain Master Craftsman as a bonus feat even if you do not meet the normal prerequisites. This trait replaces defensive training and hatred.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
